channel.title: FMCG & consumer · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on FMCG & consumer in Indian markets. Today: mixed (+0.3).

item.title: [+1] US says it is 'very close' to finalising a trade deal with India; talks in Mumbai on 20 October
item.description:
The US Secretary of State said the deal was 'taken into account' when waiving Russia-oil sanctions. India says the first phase is in legal drafting. Escalating progress.

FMCG & consumer: mild tailwind (+1) — Textile and goods exports

Why it matters: A signed deal would cut US tariffs on Indian goods and reduce the risk of renewed Russia-oil penalties, lifting exporters and investor sentiment.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Foreign investor flows +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] Ukraine in talks with India, Turkey and Egypt to restore Black Sea grain trade as attacks spread
item.description:
Attacks have spread to Romanian and Bulgarian waters, deepening the wheat export crisis. India has pushed for safe Black Sea shipping. New talks.

FMCG & consumer: mild headwind (−1) — Edible oil costs high for now

Why it matters: A protected corridor would ease world wheat, sunflower oil and fertiliser prices for India; continued attacks keep them high.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
